verdict.rationale: Floot ships its own remote MCP server that lets AI clients build and ship full-stack apps and manage them through tools such as logs, SQL and database operations, and checkpoints, so programmatic app generation and management exists. It runs only through an MCP tool interface for AI clients, though. No general-purpose platform API is documented, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP platform API or OpenAPI spec, an explicit app create/list/delete/publish API surface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API

citations.quote: It lets you build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat — works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more
Add Floot to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any client that supports remote MCP servers
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
